files.shabads/5/2915.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2915,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":785,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33339,"last_verse_id":33344,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33339,"page_no":785,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33340,"page_no":785,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"aape takhat rachaion aakaas pataalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself established His throne, in the Akaashic ethers and the nether worlds.","ms":"The Lord of Himself established His throne, sky and the nether world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਆਕਾਸ਼ ਤੇ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਲਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ-ਰੂਪ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":33341,"page_no":785,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"hukame dharatee saajeean sachee dharam saalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the Hukam of His Command, He created the earth, the true home of Dharma.","ms":"By His order, He created the earth, the true abode of faith."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਧਰਮ ਕਮਾਣ ਲਈ ਥਾਂ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33342,"page_no":785,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"aap upai khapaidhaa sache dheen dhiaalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself created and destroys; He is the True Lord, merciful to the meek.","ms":"The True Lord, Merciful to the meek, Himself creates and destroys."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਦੀਨਾਂ ਤੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੇ! ਤੂੰ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ । "}}},{"verse_id":33343,"page_no":785,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"sabhanaa rijak sa(n)baahidhaa teraa hukam niraalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You give sustenance to all; how wonderful and unique is the Hukam of Your Command!","ms":"Thou, O Lord, reachest sustenance to all, wondrous is Thine Will."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਅਨੋਖਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਕੋਈ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਮੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ) ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਿਜ਼ਕ ਅਪੜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ, "}}},{"verse_id":33344,"page_no":785,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"aape aap varatadhaa aape pratipaalaa ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You Yourself are permeating and pervading; You Yourself are the Cherisher. ||1||","ms":"Thou Thyself pervadest all and Thyself cherisheth every one."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਆਪ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2914,"next":2916}}
files.shabads/5/2916.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2916,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":785,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":33345,"last_verse_id":33349,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33345,"page_no":785,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33346,"page_no":785,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਹਬ ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"soohab taa sohaaganee jaa ma(n)n laih sach naau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The red-robed woman becomes a happy soul-bride, only when she accepts the True Name.","ms":"Then alone, does the red-robed one becomes the true bride, when she accepts the True Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਸੂਹੇ ਵੇਸ ਵਾਲੀਏ! ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ-ਥਿਰ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ) ਨਾਮ ਮੰਨ ਲਏਂ ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਵਾਲੀ ਹੋ ਜਾਏਂ । "}}},{"verse_id":33347,"page_no":785,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਚੜੀ ਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"satigur apanaa manai lai roop chaRee taa agalaa dhoojaa naahee thaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Become pleasing to your True Guru, and you shall be totally beautified; otherwise, there is no place of rest.","ms":"Please thou thy True Guru, then alone shalt thou be greatly beautified. Within her is Truth, her face is bright and she merges in her Groom."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/5/2918.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2918,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":786,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33355,"last_verse_id":33360,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33355,"page_no":786,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33356,"page_no":786,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"hukamee sirasaT saajeean bahu bhit sa(n)saaraa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By His Command, He created the creation, the world with its many species of beings.","ms":"By His Order, the Lord that created the world of the myriad kinds of beings."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਕਈ ਕਿਸਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33357,"page_no":786,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa sache alakh apaaraa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I do not know how great Your Command is, O Unseen and Infinite True Lord.","ms":"O my Incomprehensible and Infinite True Lord, how great is Thy order, I knows not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ! the self-willed manmukh is burnt to death.","ms":"Through the red-robe of mammon, none has attained to her Groom and the unwise apostate is burnt to death."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ ਚੁਹਚੁਹੇ ਰੰਗ ਵਿਚ (ਮੋਹ ਪਾ ਕੇ) ਕਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਖਸਮ-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ, (ਅਜੇਹੀ) ਆਪ-ਹੁਦਰੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ (ਇਸ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ) ਸੜ ਮਰਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33400,"page_no":787,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"satigur miliaai soohaa ves giaa haumai vichahu maar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting the True Guru, she discards her red dress, and eradicates egotism from within.","ms":"Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal casts off the red robe of wealth and eradicates his ego from within him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲ ਪਏ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰ ਕੀਤਿਆਂ ਸ਼ੋਖ਼-ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਦੂਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":33401,"page_no":787,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"man tan rataa laal hoaa rasanaa ratee gun saar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Her mind and body are imbued with the deep red color of His Love, and her tongue is imbued, singing His Praises and excellences.","ms":"Uttering the Lord's praises, the soul and body are imbued deep scarlet and tongue too is rendered vermilion."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਨ ਤੇ ਸਰੀਰ (ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਮਜੀਠ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਲ) ਰੱਤਾ ਲਾਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੀਭ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਯਾਦ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਰੰਗੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33402,"page_no":787,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"sadhaa sohaagan sabadh man bhai bhai kare seegaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She becomes His soul-bride forever, with the Word of the Shabad in her mind; she makes the Fear of God and the Love of God her ornaments and decorations.","ms":"Enshrining the Name in her mind and making the decoration of the Lord's fear and love she becomes true bride for aye."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਡਰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ (ਆਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਦਾ) ਸੋਹਜ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਗੁਰ-ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਲਈ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਵਾਲੀ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33403,"page_no":787,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak karamee mahal paiaa pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, by His Merciful Grace, she obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and keeps Him enshrined in her heart. ||1||","ms":"Nanak by His grace, the bride attains to her Beloved's mansion and keeps Him clasped to her heart."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕਾਇਆਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2924,"next":2926}}
files.shabads/5/2926.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2926,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":33404,"last_verse_id":33408,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33404,"page_no":787,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33405,"page_no":787,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸੂਹਾ ਪਰਹਰਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"mu(n)dhe soohaa paraharahu laal karahu seegaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O bride, forsake your red dress, and decorate yourself with the crimson color of His Love.","ms":"O bride, forsake thou the red-robe and embellish thyself with scarlet colour."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ! ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮੋਹਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਦਾਰਥਾਂ ਦਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਛੱਡ ਤੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਣਾ ਜੋ (ਮਾਨੋ, ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ ਪੱਕਾ) ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33406,"page_no":787,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"aavan jaanaa veesarai gur sabadhee veechaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your comings and goings shall be forgotten, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.","ms":"Reflecting over the Guru's hymns, thine coming and going shall cease."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ) ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕਰ, ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਿਲਸਿਲਾ ਮੁੱਕ ਜਾਇਗਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33407,"page_no":787,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁੰਧ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"mu(n)dh suhaavee sohanee jis ghar sahaj bhataar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The soul-bride is adorned and beautiful; the Celestial Lord, her Husband, abides in her home.","ms":"Adorned and beauteous is the bride, in whose home, the Lord her Groom abides."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ-ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਅਡੋਲ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਬਣ ਜਾਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਖਸਮ-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":33408,"page_no":787,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਰਾਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak saa dhan raaveeaai raave raavanahaar ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the bride ravishes and enjoys Him; and He, the Ravisher, ravishes and enjoys her. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, the bride makes merry and the Enjoyer enjoys her."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਚੋਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2925,"next":2927}}
files.shabads/5/2927.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2927,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33409,"last_verse_id":33414,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33409,"page_no":787,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33410,"page_no":787,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਰਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"moh kooR kuTa(n)b hai manmukh mugadh rataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The foolish, self-willed manmukh is engrossed in false attachment to family.","ms":"The ignorant ego-centric is engrossed in the false love of the family."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ) ਮੋਹ ਕੂੜ ਤੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ (ਪ੍ਰਬਲ) ਹੈ, ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪ-ਹੁਦਰਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਇਸ ਵਿਚ ਰੱਤਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":33411,"page_no":787,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"haumai meraa kar mue kichh saath na litaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Practicing egotism and self-conceit, he dies and departs, taking nothing along with him.","ms":"He dies practising egotism and egoism and departs without taking any thing with him."},"pu":{"ss":"“ਮੈਂ, ਮੇਰੀ” ਵਿਚ (ਭਾਵ, “ਮੈਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਹਾਂ”, “ਇਹ ਧਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ” ਇਹ ਆਖ ਆਖ ਕੇ) ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਦੇ (ਏਥੇ ਖ਼ੁਆਰ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, (ਤੇ ਮਰਨ ਵੇਲੇ ਏਥੋਂ) ਕੁਝ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੈ ਤੁਰਦੇ । "}}},{"verse_id":33412,"page_no":787,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"sir upar jamakaal na sujhiee dhoojai bharamitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He does not understand that the Messenger of Death is hovering over his head; he is deluded by duality.","ms":"Misled by the love of another, he sees not the angel of death over his head."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚ ਭਟਕਣ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ) ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਮੌਤ ਖਲੋਤੀ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁੱਝਦੀ, "}}},{"verse_id":33413,"page_no":787,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"fir velaa hath na aaviee jamakaal vas kitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This opportunity will not come into his hands again; the Messenger of Death will seize him.","ms":"When death's myrmidon seizes him, then the opportunity is lost."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੇ ਜਦੋਂ ਮੌਤ ਨੇ ਆ ਨੱਪਿਆ ਤਦੋਂ ਇਹ ਗੁਆਚਾ ਸਮਾ ਮੁੜ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33414,"page_no":787,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇਹਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਿਤਾ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"jehaa dhur likh paion se karam kamitaa ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||5||","ms":"As is the pre-ordained writ, so are the deeds, he does."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੀ ਕੀਹ ਕਰਨ?) ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ (ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ) ਜੋ ਲੇਖ ਧੁਰੋਂ ਮੱਥੇ ਤੇ ਲਿਖ ਦਿੱਤੇ, ਜੀਵ ਉਹੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2926,"next":2928}}
files.shabads/5/2928.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2928,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33415,"last_verse_id":33417,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33415,"page_no":787,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33416,"page_no":787,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜੋ ਮੜਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਜਲੰਨਿੑ ॥","translit_en":"sateeaa eh na aakheean jo maRiaa lag jala(n)ni(h) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not call them 'satee', who burn themselves along with their husbands' corpses.","ms":"They are not called Satis, who burn themselves with their husbands 'corpses."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਸਤੀ (ਹੋ ਗਈਆਂ) ਨਹੀਂ ਆਖੀਦੀਆਂ ਜੋ (ਪਤੀ ਦੀ) ਲੋਥ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਸੜ ਮਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":33417,"page_no":787,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿੑ ਜਿ ਬਿਰਹੇ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਨਿੑ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak sateeaa jaaneeani(h) j birahe choT mara(n)ni(h) ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, they alone are known as 'satee', who die from the shock of separation. ||1||","ms":"Nanak they are known as Satis, who die with the sheer shock of separation."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੋ (ਪਤੀ ਦੀ ਮੌਤ ਤੇ) ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਦੀ ਹੀ ਸੱਟ ਨਾਲ ਮਰ ਜਾਣ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਤੀ (ਹੋ ਗਈਆਂ) ਸਮਝਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2927,"next":2929}}
files.shabads/5/2929.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2929,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33418,"last_verse_id":33420,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33418,"page_no":787,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33419,"page_no":787,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਭੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿੑ ॥","translit_en":"bhee so sateeaa jaaneean seel sa(n)tokh raha(n)ni(h) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are also known as 'satee', who abide in modesty and contentment.","ms":"They too are known as Satis, who abide in modesty and contentment,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹਨਾਂ ਜ਼ਨਾਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਸਤੀਆਂ ਹੀ ਸਮਝਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ-ਧਰਮ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ,"}}},{"verse_id":33420,"page_no":787,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੰਨਿੑ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"sevan saiee aapanaa nit uTh sa(n)m(h)aala(n)ni(h) ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They serve their Lord, and rise in the early hours to contemplate Him. ||2||","ms":"who wait upon their Lord and rising in the morning ever remember Him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਆਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਉੱਦਮ ਨਾਲ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਹ ਧਰਮ ਚੇਤੇ ਰੱਖਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2928,"next":2930}}
files.shabads/5/2930.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2930,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":33421,"last_verse_id":33425,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33421,"page_no":787,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33422,"page_no":787,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)taa naal maheleeaa setee ag jalaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The widows burn themselves in the fire, along with their husbands' corpses.","ms":"The wives burn themselves in the fire with their b husbands."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਸਤੀ) ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਦੇ ਜੀਉਂਦਿਆਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ,"}}},{"verse_id":33423,"page_no":787,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"je jaaneh pir aapanaa taa tan dhukh sahaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If they truly knew their husbands, then they suffer terrible bodily pain.","ms":"If they heartily love their Spouse, then suffer they great bodily and mental pang ever otherwise."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਤੀ ਨੂੰ “ਆਪਣਾ” ਸਮਝਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਤਾਂਹੀਏਂ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਸਹਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33424,"page_no":787,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"naanak ka(n)t na jaananee se kiau ag jalaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, if they did not truly know their husbands, why should they burn themselves in the fire?","ms":"Nanak if they love not their husband, why should they burn themselves in fire?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਨੂੰ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਹ ਜਾਤਾ, ਉਹ ਕਿਉਂ ਦੁੱਖ ਸਹਿਣ? "}}},{"verse_id":33425,"page_no":787,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਉ ਕੈ ਮਰਉ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"bhaavai jeevau kai marau dhoorahu hee bhaj jaeh ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whether their husbands are alive or dead, those wives remain far away from them. ||3||","ms":"Whether the husband be alive or dead, such wife remains far away from him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਤੀ ਚਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਵੇ ਚਾਹੇ ਦੁਖੀ ਹੋਵੇ ਉਹ (ਔਖੇ ਵੇਲੇ) ਨੇੜੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਢੁਕਦੀਆਂ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2929,"next":2931}}
files.shabads/5/2931.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2931,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33426,"last_verse_id":33431,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33426,"page_no":787,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33427,"page_no":787,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਧੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"tudh dhukh sukh naal upaiaa lekh karatai likhiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You created pain along with pleasure; O Creator, such is the writ You have written.","ms":"O Creator, such a writ has Thou written, that Thou hast created woe along with weal."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ! It has no form or sign."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਰੂਪ ਤੇ ਨਾਹ ਰੇਖ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੇ ਬਰਾਬਰ (ਜੀਵਾਂ ਲਈ) ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33429,"page_no":787,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"naam akhuT nidhaan hai gurmukh man vasiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an inexhaustible treasure; it abides in the mind of the Gurmukh.","ms":"The Name is an inexhaustible treasure, By Guru's grace it abides in the mind."},"pu":{"ss":"‘ਨਾਮ’ ਇਕ ਐਸਾ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਕਦੇ ਮੁੱਕਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋਇਆਂ ਇਹ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":33430,"page_no":787,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"kar kirapaa naam dhevasee fir lekh na likhiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In His Mercy, He blesses us with the Naam, and then, the writ of pain and pleasure is not written.","ms":"In His Mercy, the Lord blesses man with His Name and then no writ of weal and woe is written."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ‘ਨਾਮ’ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ (ਦੇ ਚੰਗੇ ਮੰਦੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ) ਦਾ ਲੇਖ ਮੁੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਲਿਖਦਾ । "}}},{"verse_id":33431,"page_no":787,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"sevak bhai se jan mile jin har jap japiaa ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those humble servants who serve with love, meet the Lord, chanting the Chant of the Lord. ||6||","ms":"They who embrace God's meditation; those, slaves meet Him through the slave's sentiment."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਉਹੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਹਨ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਕ-ਭਾਵ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਜਾਪ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਨ ।੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2930,"next":2932}}
files.shabads/5/2932.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2932,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33432,"last_verse_id":33434,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33432,"page_no":787,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Second Mehla:","ms":"Slok 2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33433,"page_no":787,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"jinee chalan jaaniaa se kiau kareh vithaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They know that they will have to depart, so why do they make such ostentatious displays?","ms":"Why do those, who realise that they must depart make ostentations?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਖਿਲਾਰੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਿਲਾਰਦੇ (ਭਾਵ, ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਧੰਧਿਆਂ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਿਲਾਰ ਦੇਂਦੇ) ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਇਹ ਸਮਝ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਇਥੋਂ ਚਲੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33434,"page_no":787,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"chalan saar na jaananee kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who do not know that they will have to depart, continue to arrange their affairs. ||1||","ms":"They who have no idea of departure, continue to arrange their worldly affairs."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਨਿਰੇ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਨਿਜਿੱਠਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ (ਇਥੋਂ ਆਖ਼ਰ) ਤੁਰ ਜਾਣ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਿਆਲ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦੇ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2931,"next":2933}}
files.shabads/5/2933.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2933,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33435,"last_verse_id":33437,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33435,"page_no":787,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Second Mehla:","ms":"2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33436,"page_no":787,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਤਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਲਕੇ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"raat kaaran dhan sa(n)cheeaai bhalake chalan hoi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He accumulates wealth during the night of his life, but in the morning, he must depart.","ms":"Man amasses wealth for a night and in the morning he must depart."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਰਾਤ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਧਨ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕਰੀਏ ਤੇ ਸਵੇਰੇ (ਉੱਠ ਕੇ ਓਥੋਂ) ਤੁਰ ਪੈਣਾ ਹੋਵੇ, "}}},{"verse_id":33437,"page_no":787,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak naal na chaliee fir pachhutaavaa hoi ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, it shall not go along with him, and so he regrets. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, wealth goes not with him and then does he regret."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਨਾਲ ਜਾ ਨਾ ਸਕੇ ਤਾਂ ਹੱਥ ਮਲਣੇ ਪੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2932,"next":2934}}
files.shabads/5/2934.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2934,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33438,"last_verse_id":33440,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33438,"page_no":787,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Second Mehla:","ms":"2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33439,"page_no":787,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"badhaa chaTee jo bhare naa gun naa upakaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Paying a fine under pressure, does not bring either merit or goodness.","ms":"In the fine, the prisoner pays there is neither merit nor any goodness."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਕੋਈ ਕੰਮ ਬੱਧਾ-ਰੁੱਧਾ ਕਰੇ, ਉਸ ਦਾ ਲਾਭ ਨਾਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਤੇ ਨਾਹ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਨੂੰ । "}}},{"verse_id":33440,"page_no":787,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਤੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"setee khusee savaareeaai naanak kaaraj saar ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That alone is a good deed, O Nanak, which is done by one's own free will. ||3||","ms":"Nanak, the act, which the mortal performs with his sweet will, is the best."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹੀ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਰੇ ਚੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੋ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਏ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2933,"next":2935}}
files.shabads/5/2935.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2935,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33441,"last_verse_id":33443,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33441,"page_no":787,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Second Mehla:","ms":"2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33442,"page_no":787,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤਰਫ ਨ ਜਿਪਈ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥","translit_en":"manahaTh taraf na jipiee je bahutaa ghaale ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Stubborn-mindedness will not win the Lord to one's side, no matter how much it is tried.","ms":"Man's obstinacy, however much he may practise, can win not the Lord to his side."},"pu":{"ss":"ਭਾਵੇਂ ਕਿਤਨੀ ਹੀ ਮਿਹਨਤ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਕਰੇ, ਰੱਬ ਵਾਲਾ ਪਾਸਾ ਮਨ ਦੇ ਹਠ ਨਾਲ ਜਿੱਤਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ; "}}},{"verse_id":33443,"page_no":787,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਤਰਫ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੪॥","translit_en":"taraf jinai sat bhaau dhe jan naanak sabadh veechaare ||4||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is won over to your side, by offering Him your true love, O servant Nanak, and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||4||","ms":"O serf Nanak, he who offers the Lord true love, and meditates on the Name wins Him to his side."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਇਹ) ਪਾਸਾ ਜਿੱਤਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੁਭ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨੂੰ ਵੀਚਾਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2934,"next":2936}}
files.shabads/5/2936.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2936,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":787,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33444,"last_verse_id":33449,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33444,"page_no":787,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33445,"page_no":787,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"karatai kaaran jin keeaa so jaanai soiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Creator created the world; He alone understands it.","ms":"The Creator, who created the world, He alone understands that."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਜਗਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਨੀ ਉਹ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33446,"page_no":787,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"aape sirasaT upaieean aape fun goiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself shall destroy it afterwards.","ms":"He Himself created the universe and Himself shall destroy it after wards."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨੇ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੈਦਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮੁੜ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33447,"page_no":788,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"jug chaare sabh bhav thakee kin keemat hoiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All have grown weary of wandering throughout the four ages, but none know the Lord's worth.","ms":"The whole world has grown weary of wandering through the four ages, but none knows the Lord's worth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ ਤੋਂ ਜਗਤ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਸਮੇ ਤੋਂ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਹੁਣ ਤਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਾਰ ਕੇ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੇ ਜੀਵ ਪਾਸੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗੀ ਦਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈ ਸਕਿਆ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33448,"page_no":788,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur ek vikhaaliaa man tan sukh hoiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru has shown me the One Lord, and my mind and body are at peace.","ms":"The True Guru has shown me the One Lord and my soul and body are comforted."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵਿਖਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਤਨ ਵਿਚ ਸੁਖ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33449,"page_no":788,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sadhaa salaaheeaai karataa kare su hoiee ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurmukh praises the Lord forever; that alone happens, which the Creator Lord does. ||7||","ms":"By Guru's grace, ever praise thou the Lord. That alone happens, what the Creator does."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਆਪ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਹੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ।੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2935,"next":2937}}
files.shabads/5/2937.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2937,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":788,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33450,"last_verse_id":33452,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33450,"page_no":788,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Second Mehla:","ms":"Slok 2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33451,"page_no":788,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥","translit_en":"jinaa bhau tin(h) naeh bhau much bhau nibhaviaaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have the Fear of God, are very afraid.","ms":"They who fear the Lord, have no other fear. They who fear not the Lord have much fear."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੂੰ (ਰੱਬ ਦਾ) ਡਰ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ (ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਾਲਾ ਕੋਈ) ਡਰ ਨਹੀਂ (ਮਾਰਦਾ), (ਰੱਬ ਵਲੋਂ) ਨਿਡਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ (ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦਾ) ਬਹੁਤ ਡਰ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":33452,"page_no":788,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਗਇਆਹ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak eh paTa(n)taraa tit dheebaan giaaeh ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, this mystery is revealed at the Court of the Lord. ||1||","ms":"Nanak this mystery is revealed when man is ushered into that Lord's court."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਇਹ ਨਿਰਣਾ ਤਦੋਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉਸ (ਰੱਬੀ) ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿਚ ਅੱਪੜੇ (ਭਾਵ, ਜਦੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜੇ) ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2936,"next":2938}}

files.shabads/5/2956.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2956,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":790,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33544,"last_verse_id":33549,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33544,"page_no":790,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, First Mehla:","ms":"Slok 1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33545,"page_no":790,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਰੰਡੀਆ ਕੁਟਣੀਆ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"choraa jaaraa ra(n)ddeeaa kuTaneeaa dheebaan || vedheenaa kee dhosatee vedheenaa kaa khaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thieves, adulterers, prostitutes and pimps, make friendships with the unrighteous, and eat with the unrighteous.","ms":"It is the habit of thieves, adulterers, prostitutes and pimps,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੋਰਾਂ, ਲੱੁਚੇ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ, ਵਿਭਚਾਰਨ ਔਰਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਦੱਲੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਆਪੋ ਵਿਚ ਬਹਿਣ ਖਲੋਣ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਹਨਾਂ ਧਰਮ ਤੋਂ ਵਾਂਜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਆਪੋ ਵਿਚ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੋ ਵਿਚ ਖਾਣ ਪੀਣ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33546,"page_no":790,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"sifatee saar na jaananee sadhaa vasai saitaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They do not know the value of the Lord's Praises, and Satan is always with them.","ms":"They know not the worth of God's praise and Satan ever abides within them."},"pu":{"ss":"ਰੱਬ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੂਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ, (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ, ਮਾਨੋ) ਸਦਾ ਸ਼ੈਤਾਨ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33547,"page_no":790,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਗਦਹੁ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਖਉਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਸਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"gadhahu cha(n)dhan khauleeaai bhee saahoo siau paan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a donkey is anointed with sandalwood paste, he still loves to roll in the dirt.","ms":"If a donkey be plastered with sandal paste, he will still role with (in) dust."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਸਮਝਾਇਆਂ ਭੀ ਸਮਝਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ, ਜਿਵੇਂ) ਖੋਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਜੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਾਲ ਮਲੀਏ ਤਾਂ ਭੀ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਵਿਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਹ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ (ਪਿਛਲੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਗੇੜ ਇਸ ਮੰਦੇ ਰਾਹ ਤੋਂ ਹਟਣ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਂਦਾ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":33548,"page_no":790,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੈ ਕਤਿਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਣੀਐ ਤਾਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"naanak kooRai katiaai kooRaa taneeaai taan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, by spinning falsehood, a fabric of falsehood is woven.","ms":"Nanak, by spinning falsehood, the web of falsehood is woven."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! “ਕੂੜ” (ਦਾ ਸੂਤਰ) ਕੱਤਣ ਨਾਲ “ਕੂੜ” ਦਾ ਹੀ ਤਾਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":33549,"page_no":790,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂੜਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਛੀਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"kooRaa kapaR kachheeaai kooRaa painan maan ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"False is the cloth and its measurement, and false is pride in such a garment. ||1||","ms":"False is the cloth and its measurement. False is the raiment and the pride thereof."},"pu":{"ss":"“ਕੂੜ” ਦਾ ਹੀ ਕੱਪੜਾ ਕੱਛੀਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਪਹਿਨੀਦਾ ਹੈ (ਇਸ “ਕੂੜ”-ਰੂਪ ਪੁਸ਼ਾਕ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ “ਕੂੜ” ਹੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, “ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ”) ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2955,"next":2957}}

files.shabads/5/2958.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2958,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":790,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33554,"last_verse_id":33559,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33554,"page_no":790,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33555,"page_no":790,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"maiaa moh sabh kooR hai kooRo hoi giaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Attachment to Maya is totally false, and false are those who go that way.","ms":"The love of mammon is all false and false becomes he, who loves it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਰੋਲ ਇਕ ਛਲ ਹੈ, (ਆਖ਼ਰ) ਛਲ ਹੀ (ਸਾਬਤ) ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":33556,"page_no":790,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਝਗੜੈ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"haumai jhagaRaa paion jhagaRai jag muiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Through egotism, the world is caught in conflict and strife, and it dies.","ms":"Through pride man is involved in strife and in strifes, he perishes."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਜੀਵ ਫਸਾ ਕੇ) ‘ਹਉਮੈ’ ਦਾ ਗੇੜ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਗੇੜ ਵਿਚ (ਪੈ ਕੇ) ਜਗਤ ਦੁਖੀ ਹੋ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33557,"page_no":790,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh jhagaR chukaion iko rav rahiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurmukh is free of conflict and strife, and sees the One Lord, pervading everywhere.","ms":"By Guru's grace, the strifes are ended and man sees the Lord pervading all."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਝੰਬੇਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਆਪ ਮੁਕਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੀ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33558,"page_no":790,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa bhaujal tar giaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Recognizing that the Supreme Soul is everywhere, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.","ms":"Recognising the Pervading soul contained everywhere one crosses the dreadful world-ocean."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਇਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਤੋਂ ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":33559,"page_no":790,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਇਆ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"jot samaanee jot vich har naam samiaa ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His light merges into the Light, and he is absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||14||","ms":"His light merges in the Supreme Light, and he is absorbed in God's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦੀ ਆਤਮਾ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਵਿਚ ਲੀਨ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2957,"next":2959}}

files.shabads/5/2963.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2963,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":790,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33575,"last_verse_id":33580,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33575,"page_no":790,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33576,"page_no":790,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਤੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"dhar ma(n)gat jaachai dhaan har dheejai kirapaa kar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am a beggar at Your Door, begging for charity; O Lord, please grant me Your Mercy, and give to me.","ms":"I, a mumper of Thine door, O God, pray for alms, In Thy mercy, bless Thou me with it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! files.shabads/5/2970.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2970,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":791,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33614,"last_verse_id":33616,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33614,"page_no":791,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, First Mehla:","ms":"Slok 1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33615,"page_no":791,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂਮਲ ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਸਿ ਮਾਲ ॥","translit_en":"kaiaa koomal ful gun naanak gupas maal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the fresh leaves of the body, and the flowers of virtue, Nanak has weaved his garland.","ms":"With the fresh leaves of the body and the flowers of virtues, Nanak weaves garland."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਸਰੀਰ (ਮਾਨੋ, ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੂਟਿਆਂ ਦੀ) ਕੂਮਲੀ ਹੈ, (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ) ਗੁਣ (ਇਸ ਕੋਮਲ ਟਹਣੀ ਨੂੰ, ਮਾਨੋ) ਫੁੱਲ ਹਨ, (ਕੋਈ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲਾ ਬੰਦਾ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਦਾ) ਹਾਰ ਗੁੰਦਦਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":33616,"page_no":791,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਚੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਡਾਲ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"enee fulee rau kare avar k chune'eeh ddaal ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is pleased with such garlands, so why pick any other flowers? ||1||","ms":"The Lord desires such garlands why then selectest thou other branches?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਲਗਨ ਲਾਏ ਤਾਂ (ਮੂਰਤੀਆਂ ਅੱਗੇ ਭੇਟ ਰੱਖਣ ਲਈ) ਹੋਰ ਡਾਲੀਆਂ ਚੁਣਨ ਦੀ ਕੀਹ ਲੋੜ? ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2969,"next":2971}}
files.shabads/5/2971.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2971,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":791,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33617,"last_verse_id":33619,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33617,"page_no":791,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Second Mehla:","ms":"2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33618,"page_no":791,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"naanak tinaa basa(n)t hai jin(h) ghar vasiaa ka(n)t ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, it is the spring season for those, within whose homes their Husband Lord abides.","ms":"Nanak they, In whose home their Spouse abides, enjoy the spring season."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ (ਜੀਵ-) ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਖਸਮ ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਭਾ ਦੀ ਬਸੰਤ ਰੁੱਤ ਆਈ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":33619,"page_no":791,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਤ ਦਿਸਾਪੁਰੀ ਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਲੰਤ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"jin ke ka(n)t dhisaapuree se ahinis fireh jala(n)t ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But those, whose Husband Lord is far away in distant lands, continue burning, day and night. ||2||","ms":"They, whose spouse is in distant land, continue burning day and night."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਖਸਮ ਪਰਦੇਸ ਵਿਚ (ਗਏ ਹੋਏ) ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਸੜਦੀਆਂ ਫਿਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2970,"next":2972}}
files.shabads/5/2972.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2972,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":791,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":33620,"last_verse_id":33625,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33620,"page_no":791,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":33621,"page_no":791,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥","translit_en":"aape bakhase dhiaa kar gur satigur bachanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Merciful Lord Himself forgives those who dwell upon the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.","ms":"If the mortal dwells on the great True Guru's Word, the Lord Himself mercifully pardons him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਚ ਜੋੜ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰ ਕੇ (‘ਨਾਮ’ ਦੀ) ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33622,"page_no":791,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ ॥","translit_en":"anadhin sevee gun ravaa man sachai rachanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Night and day, I serve the True Lord, and chant His Glorious Praises; my mind merges into Him.","ms":"Night and day I serve the True Lord, utter His praises and merge my soul in Him."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰ) ਮੈਂ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਾਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਚੇਤੇ ਕਰਾਂ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੈਂ ਸੱਚੇ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33623,"page_no":791,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ ॥","translit_en":"prabh meraa bea(n)t hai a(n)t kinai na lakhanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My God is infinite; no one knows His limit.","ms":"Infinite is my Lord, None knows His limit."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੇ ਜੀਵ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ; "}}},{"verse_id":33624,"page_no":791,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੀ ॥","translit_en":"satigur charanee lagiaa har naam nit japanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Grasping hold of the feet of the True Guru, meditate continually on the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਰਨ ਪਿਆਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨਿੱਤ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":33625,"page_no":791,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਘਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਚਨੀ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"jo ichhai so fal paisee sabh gharai vich jachanee ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus you shall obtain the fruits of your desires, and all wishes shall be fulfilled within your home. ||18||","ms":"He obtains the fruit, which he desires and all his wishes are fulfilled in his very home."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਦਾ ਹੈ) ਉਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਜਿਸ ਫਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2971,"next":2973}}
files.shabads/5/2973.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2973,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":791,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33626,"last_verse_id":33628,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33626,"page_no":791,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, First Mehla:","ms":"Slok 1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33627,"page_no":791,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਸੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"pahil basa(n)tai aagaman pahilaa maulio soi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Spring brings forth the first blossoms, but the Lord blossoms earlier still.","ms":"The spring brings bloom but He, the Lord blooms earlier still."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਸੰਤ ਰੁੱਤ ਆਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":33628,"page_no":791,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਤੁ ਮਉਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਮਉਲਿਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"jit mauliaai sabh mauleeaai tiseh na maulih koi ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By His blossoming, everything blossoms; no one else causes Him to blossom forth. ||1||","ms":"By his blooming, everything blooms, but He needs none else to blossom."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦੇ ਖਿੜਨ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਖਿੜਦੀ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਿੜਾਂਦਾ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2972,"next":2974}}
files.shabads/5/2974.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2974,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":791,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33629,"last_verse_id":33631,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33629,"page_no":791,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Second Mehla:","ms":"2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33630,"page_no":791,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"pahil basa(n)tai aagaman tis kaa karahu beechaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He blossoms forth even earlier than the spring; reflect upon Him.","ms":"Meditate thou on Him, who comes earlier than the spring season."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ (ਦੇ ਗੁਣਾਂ) ਦੀ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੋ ਜੋ ਬਸੰਤ ਰੱੁੱਤ ਦੇ ਆਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਮਉਲਦਾ ਹੈ);"}}},{"verse_id":33631,"page_no":791,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak so saalaaheeaai j sabhasai dhe aadhaar ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, praise the One who gives Support to all. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, praise thou Him who gives support to all."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰੀਏ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2973,"next":2975}}
files.shabads/5/2975.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2975,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":19,"page_no":791,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":33632,"last_verse_id":33634,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Soohee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":33632,"page_no":791,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੨ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa doojaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Second Mehla:","ms":"2nd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":33633,"page_no":791,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"miliaai miliaa naa milai milai miliaa je hoi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By uniting, the united one is not united; he unites, only if he is united.","ms":"By uniting outwardly, the united one unites not, he meets, if he meets inwardly."},"pu":{"ss":"ਨਿਰਾ ਕਹਿਣ ਨਾਲ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹਾਂ ਮੇਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਮੇਲ ਤਾਂ ਹੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚੁ-ਮੁਚ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਵੇ"}}},{"verse_id":33634,"page_no":791,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar aatamai jo milai miliaa kaheeaai soi ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But if he unites deep within his soul, then he is said to be united. ||3||","ms":"He who meets in spirit, is said to have really met."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਿਚ ਮਿਲੇ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਆਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2974,"next":2976}}
